Signed event deliveries to your endpoints, with retries.

:::caution
Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_COMPUTE=experimental`.
:::

## List webhooks

`GET /v1/webhooks` (SDK method `listWebhooks`)

A key needs `account:admin`. Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_COMPUTE=experimental`.

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account` | string | no | The account to act in: the caller's personal account (the default for a person) or an organisation they belong to. An API key always acts in its own account, and naming another is `forbidden`. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [WebhookList](/api/reference/types/#webhooklist) (`application/json`). The webhooks.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Create a webhook

`POST /v1/webhooks` (SDK method `createWebhook`)

Its signing secret is answered once. A key needs `account:admin`. Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_COMPUTE=experimental`.

**Body**: [CreateWebhookBody](/api/reference/types/#createwebhookbody)

**Answers**

- `201`: [WebhookWithSecret](/api/reference/types/#webhookwithsecret) (`application/json`). The webhook and its signing secret.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `429` exhausted. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Get a webhook

`GET /v1/webhooks/{webhookId}` (SDK method `getWebhook`)

A key needs `account:admin`. Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_COMPUTE=experimental`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `webhookId` | string | yes | The webhook's ID. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [Webhook](/api/reference/types/#webhook) (`application/json`). The webhook.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Change a webhook

`PATCH /v1/webhooks/{webhookId}` (SDK method `updateWebhook`)

A key needs `account:admin`. Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_COMPUTE=experimental`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `webhookId` | string | yes | The webhook's ID. |

**Body**: [UpdateWebhookBody](/api/reference/types/#updatewebhookbody)

## Delete a webhook

`DELETE /v1/webhooks/{webhookId}` (SDK method `deleteWebhook`)

Its queued deliveries are dropped. A key needs `account:admin`. Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_COMPUTE=experimental`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `webhookId` | string | yes | The webhook's ID. |

**Answers**

- `204`: no body. Deleted.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Rotate a webhook's signing secret

`POST /v1/webhooks/{webhookId}/rotate` (SDK method `rotateWebhookSecret`)

Deliveries are signed with the new secret from now; one already under way may carry the old signature. A key needs `account:admin`. Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_COMPUTE=experimental`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `webhookId` | string | yes | The webhook's ID. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [WebhookWithSecret](/api/reference/types/#webhookwithsecret) (`application/json`). The webhook and its new secret.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Send a test delivery

`POST /v1/webhooks/{webhookId}/test` (SDK method `testWebhook`)

Sends a signed `sandbox.created` event for a made-up sandbox now. A key needs `account:admin`. Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_COMPUTE=experimental`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `webhookId` | string | yes | The webhook's ID. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [WebhookDelivery](/api/reference/types/#webhookdelivery) (`application/json`). The delivery, made.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## List a webhook's deliveries

`GET /v1/webhooks/{webhookId}/deliveries` (SDK method `listWebhookDeliveries`)

The last 30 days, newest first. A key needs `account:admin`. Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_COMPUTE=experimental`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `webhookId` | string | yes | The webhook's ID. |

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | integer | no | At most this many; default 50. (minimum 1, maximum 500) |
| `cursor` | string | no | A previous page's `nextCursor`. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [WebhookDeliveryPage](/api/reference/types/#webhookdeliverypage) (`application/json`). A page of deliveries.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).
